user.title: Advent Calendar
user.description: Choose a parent PIN (4-8 digits). It protects the calendar settings and custom doors, and works on any Home Assistant account. After setup, add the card `custom:advent-calendar-card` to a dashboard.

error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be 4 to 8 digits.

abort.already_configured: Advent Calendar is already set up.

init.title: Change parent PIN
init.description: Enter a new parent PIN (4-8 digits).

error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be 4 to 8 digits.

trigger_type.door_opened_day: The door for a specific day is opened
trigger_type.finale_opened: The final door is opened (Christmas / last night of Hanukkah)
trigger_type.door_opened_on_date: The door for a chosen date is opened
trigger_type.door_waiting_on_date: The door for a chosen date is waiting to be opened

door_opened.name: Advent Calendar door opened
door_opened.description: Triggers when any door of the Advent Calendar is opened.

door_opened_day.name: Advent Calendar door for a day opened
door_opened_day.description: Triggers when the door with a given day number is opened.

day.name: Day number
day.description: Day number of the door, for example 25 for Christmas.

door_opened_on_date.name: Advent Calendar door for a date opened
door_opened_on_date.description: Triggers when the door dated on a chosen calendar date is opened, on that date or any later day.

date.name: Calendar date
date.description: The date printed on the door.

door_waiting_on_date.name: Advent Calendar door for a date is waiting
door_waiting_on_date.description: Triggers just after midnight on a chosen date, when that date's door becomes available to open.

date.name: Calendar date
date.description: The date printed on the door.

finale_opened.name: Advent Calendar finale opened
finale_opened.description: Triggers when the last door is opened (Christmas Day, or the 8th night of Hanukkah).

custom_door_opened.name: Advent Calendar parent-written door opened
custom_door_opened.description: Triggers when a door with a parent-written surprise is opened.
